topic_switch.instructions: The state has `prior_context` — what a coding session has been working on so far (its title, the latest compaction summary, the most recent user requests) — and `new_request`, the message the user just submitted after an idle gap. Does the new request start work that does not need that prior context?

criteria.true: A different task, feature, area, or question: carrying it out would never consult the prior work
criteria.false: Continues, corrects, reviews, or asks about the prior work, or is a short follow-up that only makes sense with that context
